public_rationale: ChatGPT combined a very large weekly audience with millions of paying enterprise users before publication. That contradicts the ordinary reading of no compelling application with a clear payment model. It does not settle a stronger claim that OpenAI lacked a sustainably profitable business.
limitations: The result depends on interpreting killer app through demonstrated demand and business model through established monetisation.
Usage figures originate with OpenAI; the selected news reports are not independent measurements.
The accessible primary subscription announcement predates the target month.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI still has no killer app with a clear business model.

statement.excerpt: There is still no killer app with a clear business model.

our_interpretation: The context limits the claim to OpenAI's applications.

A killer app ordinarily means an application with substantial demonstrated demand. A clear business model means an identifiable way of charging customers that has attracted paying users; it does not necessarily mean established profitability.
Use February 2025, the latest completed month before publication, to assess the ongoing state.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence shows that OpenAI lacked an application combining substantial adoption with an established, commercially used payment model in February 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one OpenAI application had substantial adoption and an established payment model with paying customers in February 2025.

evidence.locator: Opening report, paragraph beginning 'It is possible'
evidence.explanation: The reported weekly audience establishes substantial adoption under the stated reading. These are company-supplied figures reported through an interview, not an independent audience audit.
Paying enterprise accounts demonstrate commercial use of a defined payment model. The count concerns users, not two million separate businesses.

evidence.locator: Paragraph following the subscription benefits list
evidence.explanation: OpenAI's original announcement documents its paid-subscription approach. It establishes the model's origin, while e2 supplies evidence of paying customers during the target month.
